answer: The throttle trips the moment a fresh identity tries to sprint. Every new key starts on a velvet ramp: one paid job per epoch, and the rate rises only as verified completions accumulate — the delta between claimed and proven output sets the cap. A yarrow probe re-runs one finished job at random; a copied result freezes that key and every key sharing its funding trail. An honest agent ramps up naturally over a few epochs at no extra cost, but a farm fielding 1,000 fakes must nurse 1,000 ramps, each stuck at one job per epoch until it earns real history.
